title: Inflexibility and Leverage
authors: Lifeng Gu; Dirk Hackbarth; Yuxin Luo
department: finance (per abstract: accepted by Bo Becker)
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment estimated on its own. The paper regresses leverage (ld, td) on a continuous firm-level inflexibility measure with industry-year (and firm) FE and controls (Tables 2-8), uses IV (Table 10), and in Table 9 exploits staggered interstate bank deregulation (dereg_dummy = 1 from the state's Rice-Strahan deregulation year onward) only as a credit-supply shock interacted with inflexibility: reghdfe ld c.inflex#c.dereg_dummy inflex dereg_dummy $control, absorb(industry_year state_year firmid), cluster stateid, and a version with the high/low inflexibility dummy rank2_inflex_dereg. The dereg_dummy main effect is absorbed by state-year FE, so every column is a treatment-by-characteristic (continuous or subgroup) interaction with time-varying controls, which the protocol excludes; no column reports the deregulation effect itself.
design_notes: Codes/table9.do lines 32 and 42; setup.do labels dereg_dummy 'Dereg' and rank2_inflex_dereg; Data_dictionary.txt: dereg_dummy = 1 from the firm's state interstate-deregulation year onward, first_adopt_year = state adoption year. Analysis panel analysis_panel.dta (Compustat/CRSP 1970-2023) not shipped.
estimators_reported: staggered deregulation x inflexibility interaction with state-year, industry-year and firm FE (Table 9)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Interstate bank deregulation is staggered across states (Rice and Strahan 2010), but it enters only as a moderator; cohort count not relevant to any reported column.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment enters only interacted with a continuous characteristic (inflex) or a subgroup dummy; main effect absorbed by state-year FE; time-varying controls
specs.treatment_definition: dereg_dummy = 1 from the firm's headquarters state's interstate bank deregulation year onward
specs.controls: profit size bm tangible dividendpayer vol

data_files: no data files (Compustat/CRSP licensed; auxiliary state-year panels described but not shipped)
data_files_note: README: primary data cannot be redistributed; instructions for rebuilding the panel from WRDS are provided.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, ivreghdfe, esttab); SAS for Table 3 aggregation; MATLAB for figures.
priority_note: Not eligible (continuous treatment interaction); data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The staggered deregulation indicator exists in the data but is never estimated as a stand-alone binary DiD.
